text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho—the final crown of the
Classics,
held in Kyoto on a
3,000-meter track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The showdown between Ryan and
McQueen will
unfold here at this grand
event.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've always lost against
McQueen in
everything... Always.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
In elegance, cuteness, spirit... I could
never come
close to her.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But I'm not mad that I lost! Being so
weak in
comparison made me respect
her! It made me
wanna catch up to her!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And it really made me want to win
against
someone who I couldn't beat.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
My lackluster performance has kind of
been a
blessing in disguise!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: It looks like you've moved past that.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm not planning on letting things
end the
way they began.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You seem to have found your dignity,
Ryan.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's commendable that you've made it
this far,
truly. However...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This is a race that I cannot possibly lose.

3000-meters is the distance I excel at
most.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I'm not going to hold back.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
McQueen... To you, the Classics may not
carry
the same importance of the Tenno
Sho...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But I'm glad that I get to run here with
you today!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm happy to be right beside you for this

once-in-a-lifetime race!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're quite straightforward, you
know that?
But that simplicity may be
what's most frightening
about you.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Let's go. Here, under the
chrysanthemums, we'll
have our first real
contest since that scrimmage!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
